about: Mail seeded into the test home's GreenMail mailbox before the onboarding run. Every name and address is invented. The noticers should find one reply owed (Priya's question) and one renewal (the domain). Subjects are what the Inbox Zip must list.

messages.subject: Saturday order for the school fair
messages.body:
